verdict.rationale: Metorial documents session-based tool filters (allow/deny lists set by developers) and merging tools from multiple providers into a session, but there is no evidence of an agent-facing meta-tool (e.g., a 'search_tools'/'load_tool' function) that lets the agent itself discover and load tools dynamically at runtime instead of receiving a large static tool list. The filtering mechanisms shown are configured by developers ahead of time, not driven by the agent searching at inference time.
